verdict: M199 is a strong, independently reproducible abstract DSE milestone. Decoupling raw scan width from stable descriptor emit width is valid under the stated always-accept causal model, and S4/F2 is the right RTL screen point. It is not yet a physical, complete-FC2, FFN, or system speedup.

stage0_bypass.assessment: Exact and worth a cheap stage-mode bit, but only a 0.1185 percent cleanup rather than a headline contribution.

width_tradeoff.assessment: The abstract cycle/width tradeoff is exact; an area, energy, or timing advantage still requires matched S4/F2 and S4/F4 Synopsys DC evidence.

hammer_findings.finding: Independent little-endian payload decoding and a separately authored causal FIFO/max-plus recurrence exactly reproduce all aggregate, per-stage, and nine S/F wall-cycle points.

S4/F2 post-emit backlog is exactly bounded by four for the frozen payload. Exhaustive 16-beat attacks hit the bound and preserve original beat order with no drop or duplicate across full, partial, zero, tail, and multi-window cases.

A depth-four registered reservoir is sufficient only with same-cycle stable emission/bypass. The worst S4/F2 merge presents up to six ordered candidates (two carried plus four arrivals) before two are emitted; downstream descriptor stalls are not modeled. RTL must stall the scanner or provide additional capacity without violating order.

The abstract boundary recurrence begins a new S4 scan group at an arbitrary raw-beat position after a mid-lane full-window close. Standalone RTL must prove residual-lane skid/rotate handling or an equivalent unaligned fetch contract; otherwise the sealed window-boundary rounding is not implementable at the stated cycles.

Before any complete-FC2 cycle admission, the dual-window accepted-head advance, partial/odd-tail release, token/window/epoch tags, SRAM response latency and stale quarantine, Acc24/commit path, and result backpressure need an integrated exact scoreboard.

The S4/F2 versus S4/F4 selection is currently a logical bus-width hypothesis. Halving descriptor output width does not prove half area or energy because the stable compaction/merge network may dominate; synthesize both at the same 3 ns target.
Empty tokens charge scan plus two fixed cycles, nonempty tokens charge one fixed close cycle, and tokens are fully serialized. These are exact model conventions without controller timing evidence.
Stage-0 fusion bypass is arithmetically correct but improves the selected abstract point by only 0.1185 percent. Keep it as a mode bit; do not present it as an independent speedup contribution.
